thread:
maria: Heads-up  need final landing copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private that ties to launch posts, webinar, and inbound routing. Copy freeze Mon EOD. Who owns hero + CTAs + forms?

alex: Ill take hero variants. Will produce 3 tight lines + per-mode subcopy by tomorrow AM.

sam: Ill draft the webinar benchmark paragraph and two tiny customer vignettes. @alex can you pull p50 latency + tokens/sec for our default model family?

jordan: Routing plan: Hosted -> lightweight trial form; Dedicated -> sales intake (6 fields); Private -> enterprise intake + compliance checklist. Hidden fields: product_mode, campaign_source.

kevin: Quick hero seeds (pick one family):
- Performance: "Predictable low-latency LLM inference for production"
- Economics: "Lower inference cost without sacrificing quality"
- Reliability: "SLA-backed inference with graceful fallbacks"
Keep family consistent and tune subcopy per mode.

maria: For the copy pass I want: final hero, one supporting paragraph, three bullets (tech diffs), CTA mapping, microcopy for top-of-funnel form (privacy + response time). Developer-forward tone.

alex: First-pass (compact):
- Hosted hero: "Start building with our Hosted API"
  Hosted sub: "Streaming, SDKs, transparent per-token pricing, instant onboarding."
  CTA: "Start free trial" -> /signup?utm=hosted_launch
- Dedicated hero: "Reserved capacity for predictable throughput"
  Dedicated sub: "SLA-backed GPU pools, autoscaling, throughput guarantees."
  CTA: "Request capacity quote" -> /sales/dedicated
- Private hero: "Private deployment for regulated workloads"
  Private sub: "VPC/on-prem options, KMS/HSM, audit logs."
  CTA: "Contact enterprise" -> /enterprise/contact

sam: Webinar blurb: "In representative chat workloads median token latency ~30ms; batching + KV cache delivered ~2.5x throughput. Customers using cache+quant reported 30-45% lower inference cost with comparable eval scores." Two mini-cases: "Acme.ai: 42% cost drop"; "Shoply: 28% tail latency drop." Slides attached to review.

jordan: Forms detail:
- Hosted (light): email, company (opt), use_case. Auto-provision trial + onboarding drip.
- Dedicated (sales): company, expected_rps, preferred_region, contact_phone, primary_contact_role. -> SDR queue A + calendar link.
- Private (enterprise): company, security_contact, compliance_needs, nda_required. -> AE + legal intake.
Track hidden: product_mode, campaign_source, utm_content.

kevin: A/B idea: cohorts = webinar_attendees / organic_search / paid_social. Test 3 hero variants for 14 days. Primary metric = trial_start_rate; secondary = MQLs for Dedicated/Private.

maria: Analytics events: hero_impression, cta_click, form_submit, trial_provisioned. Ensure product_mode in event payloads. Microcopy: "We respect your privacy. We won't share your info. Trial access within 24 hours."

ops-bot: Event created: "Landing copy + webinar alignment review" Wed 14:00 UTC. Attendees: maria, alex, sam, jordan, kevin. Link: https://cal.example.com/6754321000

maria: Final asks before review: alex (mockups + UTM schema), sam (2 slide visuals), jordan (form schema + routing matrix), kevin (cohort list). See you at 14:00. :thumbsup:
